title: Keep the overview clear
cues: A complex system can be hard to read in one diagram.
复杂系统很难在一张图中清楚呈现。
Keep the overview clear.
让概览保持清晰。
Open a component when you need more detail.
需要更多细节时，再展开组件。

title: Open useful internals
cues: This is the Transformer example in Archify Labs.
这是 Archify Labs 中的 Transformer 示例。
Select Transformer Layer and open its internal architecture.
选择 Transformer Layer，然后打开内部架构。
The child expands below the main diagram.
子图在主图下方展开。
Its local components have their own Semantic Passport.
局部组件有各自的 Semantic Passport。

title: Export each view independently
cues: The Export menu offers two targets.
Export 菜单提供两个导出目标。
Main diagram exports the overview.
Main diagram 导出主图概览。
Current subarchitecture exports only the open child.
Current subarchitecture 只导出当前子图。
This child SVG contains seven local components.
这张子图 SVG 仅包含七个局部组件。
The two exports stay independent.
两种导出彼此独立。

title: Return to your place
cues: Use Back to model to return.
点击 Back to model 返回。
The page restores your scroll position and parent selection.
页面恢复原来的滚动位置和父组件选择。
Larger children can scroll.
较大的子图可以滚动查看。
The main diagram keeps its original behavior.
主图保留原有行为。

title: Explore official BAGEL code
cues: The BAGEL example follows the official inference code.
BAGEL 示例依据官方推理代码绘制。
Open context assembly to inspect text, vision, and VAE paths.
展开上下文组装，查看文本、视觉和 VAE 路径。
Open the MoT layer to see attention and separate feed-forward paths.
展开 MoT 层，查看注意力和分别处理的前馈路径。
Source links point to a fixed repository revision.
源码链接指向固定的仓库版本。

title: Follow a Lance query
cues: The Lance example follows a dataset query.
Lance 示例展示数据集查询路径。
Open the scanner to inspect its query plan.
展开 Scanner，查看查询计划。
Some stages depend on the query options.
部分阶段由查询选项决定。
Then open the Arrow stream bridge.
再展开 Arrow 数据流桥接层。
See how Rust batches reach Python.
查看 Rust 中的批次如何传到 Python。

title: Try the Labs examples
cues: These views are optional additions in Labs.
这些视图是 Labs 中的可选增量功能。
Each child stays one level deep with up to twelve components.
子图仅支持一层，最多包含十二个组件。
Try Transformer, BAGEL, and Lance in the gallery.
在 Gallery 中体验 Transformer、BAGEL 和 Lance。
Bring a real diagram and share what you find.
欢迎用真实架构图试用，并分享你的发现。
